children: Palm oil futures ended lower, weighed by weaker soybean oil and crude oil prices, says David Ng, a trader at Kuala Lumpur-based Iceberg X. Concerns about sluggish exports and rising inventories continue to pressure sentiment, he adds. Ng expects prices to find support at 4,700 ringgit a ton and face resistance at 4,850 ringgit a ton. The Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for December delivery fell 42 ringgit to 4,768 ringgit a ton. (jiahui.huang@wsj.com; @ivy_jiahuihuang)
